main_task: Call people who asked about Green Meadows plots and book a site visit this weekend.
sources: Plots start at Rs 12,50,000. Site visits are on Saturday and Sunday from 10 am to 5 pm.

answer.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, I am calling from Green Meadows about the plots you asked about. Can you talk for a minute?

stages.name: Right person
stages.instruction: Confirm you are speaking to the person who asked.

stages.name: Price
stages.instruction: Answer the price question from the sources.

stages.name: Book a visit
stages.instruction: Ask which weekend day suits them.
stages.sounds_like: Would Saturday or Sunday suit you?

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Read back the day and thank them.
stages.sounds_like: Thank you, we will see you then.
